behaviors.description: Distinguish isolated, exposed and shared child sandbox PID namespaces.
behaviors.preconditions: A live independent parent app, with its actual process identified by public instance enumeration.
behaviors.expected: Only sharing reuses the parent namespace; exposure nests the child under it; public enter observes the exact child environment only for the exposed/shared modes. An absent parent is rejected.

mappings.rationale: Kernel PID namespace identities and a read from inside the parent establish real process visibility rather than option serialization.

surface_assertions.rationale: The selected live parent controls child namespace placement; an absent parent fails.
The child enters a nested namespace and its exact environment becomes readable inside the parent.
The child shares the parent's actual kernel PID namespace and is visible from within it.
